steps.message: I want to be able to provide my own custom final_answer tool when initializing an agent, while still having the system automatically provide a default final_answer tool if I don't specify one. Currently, the system always overrides any final_answer tool I provide during initialization, which prevents me from using my own customized version. I need the agent initialization to respect when I've already included a final_answer tool in my tools list, and only add the default FinalAnswerTool if I haven't provided one myself. This should work consistently across all agent types and maintain backward compatibility so existing code continues to work without changes. The solution should specifically address the issue described in problem #759 while being related to the broader functionality discussed in issue #769.

608:     def execute_tool_call(self, tool_name: str, arguments: Union[Dict[str, str], str]) -> Any:
609:         """
610:         Execute tool with the provided input and returns the result.
611:         This method replaces arguments with the actual values from the state if they refer to state variables.
612: 
613:         Args:
614:             tool_name (`str`): Name of the Tool to execute (should be one from self.tools).
615:             arguments (Dict[str, str]): Arguments passed to the Tool.
616:         """
617:         available_tools = {**self.tools, **self.managed_agents}
618:         if tool_name not in available_tools:
619:             error_msg = f"Unknown tool {tool_name}, should be instead one of {list(available_tools.keys())}."
620:             raise AgentExecutionError(error_msg, self.logger)
621: 
622:         try:
623:             if isinstance(arguments, str):
624:                 if tool_name in self.managed_agents:
625:                     observation = available_tools[tool_name].__call__(arguments)
626:                 else:
627:                     observation = available_tools[tool_name].__call__(arguments, sanitize_inputs_outputs=True)
628:             elif isinstance(arguments, dict):
629:                 for key, value in arguments.items():
630:                     if isinstance(value, str) and value in self.state:
631:                         arguments[key] = self.state[value]
632:                 if tool_name in self.managed_agents:
633:                     observation = available_tools[tool_name].__call__(**arguments)
634:                 else:
635:                     observation = available_tools[tool_name].__call__(**arguments, sanitize_inputs_outputs=True)
636:             else:
637:                 error_msg = f"Arguments passed to tool should be a dict or string: got a {type(arguments)}."
638:                 raise AgentExecutionError(error_msg, self.logger)
639:             return observation
640:         except Exception as e:
641:             if tool_name in self.tools:
642:                 tool = self.tools[tool_name]
643:                 error_msg = (
644:                     f"Error when executing tool {tool_name} with arguments {arguments}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}\nYou should only use this tool with a correct input.\n"
